top_categories.workout_context: Silver City Century's Iowa rolling gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Silver City Century's Iowa rolling, Local event forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 62 miles.
At Silver City Century, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Silver City Century. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Silver City Century's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
62 miles on Iowa rolling gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on Iowa rolling gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
When someone attacks on Iowa rolling gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Silver City Century, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Base fitness for Silver City Century. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Silver City Century’s 62 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
